responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module specifies the extensive type-building API implemented by m2type.cc. It exposes procedures for constructing subranges, sets, pointers, arrays, records, variants, enumerations, constructors, function types, built-in type declarations, range and size queries, signedness conversion, and access to predefined Modula-2, ISO, and C interop types, serving as the main Modula-2-side contract for GCC type-tree creation.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition-module view of the m2type family: unlike m2type.cc’s implementation and m2type.h’s C/C++ declarations, this file exposes the same type-construction services as a FOR "C" Modula-2 interface using Modula-2 procedure signatures and types such as Tree and ADDRESS.
